$comment: Haijun Tracks Discovery - Haijun adaptation of Agent Tracks Discovery 0.2.0 (https://schemas.agentskills.io/discovery/0.2.0/schema.json). Adapted for Haijun ecosystem (https://haijun.my.id, https://tracks.web.id, https://agent.tracks.web.id). Changes: TRACK.md -> TRACK.md, track -> track, agentskills.io -> haijun/track equivalents. Provides discovery index for Haijun Tracks at /.well-known/haijun-tracks/index.json and /.well-known/agent-tracks/index.json.
title: Haijun Tracks Discovery Index
description: Discovery index for Haijun Tracks. Adapted from Agent Tracks Discovery 0.2.0 spec. Lists all published tracks with metadata, distribution URLs (TRACK.md), and integrity digests. Haijun Tracks are Markdown-based knowledge modules (TRACK.md) replacing TRACK.md.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI for this discovery index (Haijun Tracks Discovery)

tracks.description: List of published Haijun Tracks (adapted from 'tracks' in agentskills.io spec). Each entry corresponds to a TRACK.md track.

name.description: Track slug / unique identifier (kebab-case). Original spec field 'name' for track; renamed for track. Must be unique within the index.

type.description: Distribution type for the track. 'track-md' = TRACK.md fetched on demand (analogous to 'track-md'), 'archive' = packaged archive (ZIP/TAR) download.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the track does and when to use it. Adapted from track description (1-1024 chars recommended).
examples: Extracts text and tables from PDF files. Use when working with PDFs or when the user mentions PDFs, forms, or document extraction. (Haijun Track)

url.description: URL to the track's TRACK.md file (for track-md) or archive file (for archive). Original spec used TRACK.md URL; adapted to TRACK.md. Typically hosted at /.well-known/haijun-tracks/<slug>/TRACK.md or /.well-known/agent-tracks/<slug>/TRACK.md

digest.description: Integrity digest for the track content (sha256 hash hex). Format: 'sha256:<hex>'. Allows agents to detect changes. Same as agentskills.io spec digest.

version.description: Track version (semver). Optional but recommended for Haijun registry.

license.description: SPDX license identifier for the track

tags.description: Tags for track categorization and discovery (Haijun-specific extension)

repository.description: Source repository URL for the track

metadata.description: Additional metadata for the track (Haijun extension)

registry.description: Registry base URL for Haijun Tracks (replaces https://schemas.agentskills.io)

version.description: Discovery index format version (mirrors 0.2.0 from agentskills.io)

tracks.name: orders
tracks.description: Place a Haijun Tracks order for drinks or desserts and track its status. Use when a customer wants to order from the menu or asks about an order they already placed. (Haijun Track adapted from track)
